title: Generate UTM link
subtitle: Tag this {{surface}} link so campaign traffic is attributed in your reports.
subtitleFor: Tag the {{surface}} link for "{{name}}" so campaign traffic is attributed in your reports.

destination.label: Destination
destination.missing: No shareable link is available yet.

utm_source.label: Source
utm_source.hint: Where the traffic comes from — the platform or partner.

utm_medium.label: Medium
utm_medium.hint: How it reaches them — social, cpc, email, sms, qr.

utm_campaign.label: Campaign
utm_campaign.hint: The campaign name. Use the same value on every link in the campaign.

utm_content.label: Content
utm_content.hint: Optional. Tells two versions of the same ad or post apart.

utm_term.label: Term
utm_term.hint: Optional. The paid keyword this link was bought against.

preview.label: Generated link
preview.empty: Fill in source and medium to build the link.

validation.sourceMediumRequired: Source and medium are both required — without them the visit is reported as direct traffic.
validation.campaignRequired: Your institute requires a campaign name on every generated link.
